description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named PayGradeCurrencySearchFilterParams used for filtering search results related to pay grade currencies in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes a payGradeId property, along with allowed sort fields and relevant setter/getter methods.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrencySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for encapsulating search filter parameters related to pay grade currencies, including filtering by pay grade ID and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class and sets the default sort field to 'ct.name'.

methods.name: setPayGradeId
methods.description: Sets the pay grade ID for filtering purposes.

methods.name: getPayGradeId
methods.description: Retrieves the current pay grade ID used in filtering.
